jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Digital Sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Product Manager to work in our Baltimore, Maryland office.  This is an exciting opportunity to use your experience helping the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) define product strategy and roadmap for the modernization of its legacy Contact Center CRM platform into a modern, AI-enabled, cloud-native solution.

Primary Responsibilities

The Product Manager shall own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for the CRM modernization effort, translating CMS’s business objectives into actionable, prioritized work for Agile delivery teams.

Responsibilities shall include, but are not limited to:

•        Define, articulate, and evolve the product vision and roadmap supporting CMS’s AI-driven contact center operations strategy.
•        Own and continuously prioritize the product backlog, ensuring user stories include clear, testable acceptance criteria aligned to CMS’s objectives.
•        Partner with CMS product owners, CCOG SMEs, CSRs, and supervisors to deeply understand business needs and translate them into product requirements.
•        Lead discovery sessions, design reviews, and Human-Centered Design (HCD) workshops, including interviews, surveys, focus groups, and side-by-side observations.
•        Develop prototypes, mock-ups, and journey maps for stakeholder validation prior to development.
•        Guide prioritization of the iterative AI Feature Roadmap, mapping AI capabilities to sprint cycles and defining measurable success criteria for each.
•        Collaborate with the Release Train Engineer, Solution Architect, and scrum teams during PI planning, sprint planning, and sprint reviews to ensure backlog alignment with business priorities.
•        Support definition of Go/No-Go Gate criteria and demonstrate functional parity/completeness against CMS-approved business functions at each phase gate.
•        Ensure full mapping of current NGD business functions and workflows to the modernized CRM, prioritizing functional continuity and minimal operational disruption.
•        Support development and maintenance of the New CRM Requirements Document, Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), and related sprint-cycle deliverables.
•        Champion measurable outcomes such as Average Handle Time (AHT) reduction, swivel-chair reduction, CSR satisfaction, and AI feature adoption/utilization.
•        Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and sprint progress to CMS leadership, the COR, and Leidos stakeholders through briefings and status reporting.
•        Coach and support Agile delivery teams and CMS stakeholders on Agile/Product Management best practices, tools, and artifacts.
•        Support the AI Compliance and Risk Management Plan, ensuring proposed AI features align with CMS governance, risk, and bias-mitigation requirements.
•        Facilitate stakeholder engagement planning and manage relationships across a broad range of internal (Government) and external (CSR, beneficiary/consumer) personas.
•        Support UAT planning and execution, ensuring test scenarios validate acceptance criteria and business function parity/continuity.
•        Contribute to Change Management Plan development, including training content, release communications, and adoption strategies.
•        Analyze product and enterprise Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Post-Transition Metrics to drive continuous, data-informed roadmap decisions.
•        Support Sprint Review Reports and demonstrations of working software to CMS stakeholders, including case management, knowledge integration, AI features, and external system integrations.
•        Ensure product decisions account for Section 508 accessibility, security, and FedRAMP compliance requirements.
•        Manage and document methods of communication, prioritization, and decision-making to ensure seamless collaboration across Product, Engineering, and CMS teams.
•        Actively participate in planning sessions, requirements gathering activities, design sessions, Agile modeling sessions, and other events supporting the CRM modernization.

Required Qualifications:

•        Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 10-12 years of relevant prior experience, or a minimum of 14 years of experience as a Product/Functional Manager in lieu of a degree
•        Certified SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) with minimum 5 years’ experience as a Product Manager
•        Solid experience defining and managing product roadmaps, backlogs, and release plans in an Agile/SAFe delivery environment
•        Experience translating complex business and technical requirements into user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria
•        Experience presenting product strategy and roadmaps to senior government and corporate leadership with varying technical backgrounds
•        Ability to lead and mentor product owners
•        Ability to obtain Public Trust

Preferred Qualifications:

•        Experience with CRM (e.g., Pega, Salesforce, Siebel) or contact center product management
•        Experience supporting CMS or other federal health/human services modernization programs
•        Experience facilitating Human-Centered Design (HCD) methods, including prototyping and journey mapping
•        Experience with AI-enabled product features and AI governance/compliance frameworks
•        Knowledge of federal contact center operations

jobs.title: Manufacturing Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Leidos Australia
At Leidos Australia, our work goes beyond a job title. We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life.

Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter.

Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work.

This includes:
- Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days (up to 12 extra days off per year), part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours.
- Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing.
- Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities.
- Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities.
- Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way.
- And Much More – These are just a few of the ways we invest in our people and help them thrive.

About the Team
You’ll join a team where people work with integrity, inclusion, innovation, agility, collaboration and commitment. In practice, that means sharing ownership, solving complex problems together and staying connected to the customer context, the purpose behind the work and how each role contributes to meaningful outcomes.

Mission Software Systems (MSS) brings together expertise across intelligence, software, and cloud to deliver end-to-end capability supporting the full intelligence lifecycle, from planning through to dissemination and feedback. The team fosters a culture of innovation, leveraging modern engineering practices and shared infrastructure to rapidly build, test, and deploy software solutions across a range of environments, including cloud. MSS also plays a key role in advancing technology modernisation within Government, delivering scalable and adaptable solutions for complex enterprise challenges.

The Opportunity
This role is an opportunity to lead the manufacturing contribution to complex programs, connecting program priorities with production capability, operational readiness and reliable delivery outcomes. As the Manufacturing Product Manager, you will be the primary manufacturing and operations interface across Program Management, Engineering, Sourcing, Quality and other business functions.

In this role, you will:
- Lead the development and integration of manufacturing plans from the concept phase through transition to production, supporting producibility, design-to-cost outcomes and the achievement of Manufacturing Readiness Levels.
- Own manufacturing cost and schedule commitments, including production build planning, budgets, baselines, forecasts, performance reporting and contributions to the Integrated Master Schedule.
- Coordinate Manufacturing Readiness Reviews, Production Readiness Reviews, make-or-buy activities, capital requirements, resource planning and the resolution of production risks, issues and priorities.
- Partner across multidisciplinary teams to ensure manufacturing processes, procedures and program artefacts are defined, maintained and implemented in line with organisational, contractual and quality requirements.

About You
We are looking for someone who can bring manufacturing, program delivery and commercial considerations together to support informed decisions and dependable production outcomes.

Essential:
- Experience leading manufacturing, production, industrial operations or product delivery activities within a complex engineering or regulated environment.
- Capability in developing and managing manufacturing plans, production schedules, budgets, forecasts, resource requirements and operational performance commitments.
- Experience supporting transition-to-production activities, manufacturing or production readiness reviews, risk and opportunity management, and continuous improvement.
- Ability to work collaboratively across Program Management, Operations, Engineering, Sourcing, Quality and Finance, translating program requirements into practical manufacturing outcomes.
- Well-developed stakeholder engagement, reporting and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate cost, schedule, readiness, risk and performance information across governance forums.

Advantageous:
- Experience working within Defence, aerospace or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.
- Knowledge of integrated scheduling earned value or control account management practices.
- Experience contributing to proposals, operational baselining, capital planning and make-or-buy decisions.
- A tertiary qualification in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Business or a related discipline.

This role requires the successful applicant to be an Australian citizen and hold an NV-1 security clearance.

If this role interests you, we encourage you to apply. We value different experiences and are interested in the capability and potential you could bring.

What to Expect When You Apply
Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward, respectful and easy to navigate. If your skills, experience and qualifications look aligned with the role, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you to discuss the next stage. You can expect:
- An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team
- An interview with the hiring manager or interview panel
- Any role-specific assessment, technical discussion or customer step required for the position

We’ll let you know what to expect before each stage, including who you’ll meet and how to prepare. If you need any adjustments or support during the process, please let us know.

Ready to explore what’s possible?
If this sounds like a role where you can make an impact and continue to grow, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply via the “Apply Now” button with your resume. If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact Praveena Sundarakumar, Talent Acquisition.

jobs.title: SRE Product Owner
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, technically fluent Product Owner to lead and grow a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team supporting BAN/LAN/WLAN Transport Site Reliability Engineering and Operations for a large-scale, geographically dispersed enterprise network. This individual will own the product backlog, manage and develop a team of 8–12 highly technical engineers, and partner closely with other Product Owners across the Transport portfolio (WAN, network boundary, NetDevOps) to align priorities, dependencies, and roadmaps.
This is not a generalist PO role. The ideal candidate has a working command of enterprise routing, switching, and wireless technologies — enough to credibly prioritize backlog items, evaluate technical trade-offs, translate engineering constraints for program leadership and customers, and hold their own in technical conversations with their engineers. This person will serve as the connective tissue between deep technical execution and program-level delivery, resourcing, and stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities
Product Ownership & Backlog Management
- Own, prioritize, and continuously refine the product backlog for the SRE Transport (BAN/LAN/WLAN) team, balancing customer needs, technical risk, operational stability, and mission priorities.

- Translate stakeholder, customer, and program requirements into clear, well-formed features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that technical engineers can execute against without ambiguity.

- Partner with Product Owners across other Transport domains (WAN, boundary, NetDevOps, etc.) to align cross-team roadmaps, sequence dependencies, and resolve competing priorities.

- Maintain and communicate a rolling roadmap for the Transport BAN/LAN/WLAN product line, including upcoming capability investments, technical debt, and modernization efforts.

- Make and defend prioritization calls that require understanding technical dependency chains (e.g., routing/switching changes, SD-WAN rollouts, WLAN upgrades) — not just business value scoring.

Agile Delivery & Program Execution
- Serve as the Product Owner within a SAFe Agile framework: lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, story sizing, and sprint reviews.

- Facilitate or actively participate in Daily Stand-Ups (DSUs), retrospectives, Program Increment (PI) planning, and other Agile ceremonies.

- Develop and deliver PI objectives, demonstrations, and technical progress updates to program leadership and customer stakeholders.

- Track team velocity, throughput, and delivery health in ADO; proactively surface blockers, risks, and resourcing gaps.

- Support change management processes by ensuring backlog items tied to network changes, upgrades, and deployments are properly scoped, sequenced, and reflected in change tickets.

People & Resource Management
- Manage day-to-day performance, workload distribution, and career development for a team of 8–12 technical engineers.

- Conduct 1:1s, performance check-ins, and contribute to formal performance review cycles.

- Support staffing, onboarding, and ramp-up planning for new team members; identify and address skill gaps within the team.

- Coordinate on-call rotations and off-hours maintenance coverage across the team, ensuring adequate staffing for scheduled and emergency work.

- Own team-level administrative responsibilities: timesheet/labor approvals, travel and training requests, and resource forecasting for program leadership.

Technical & Stakeholder Liaison
- Act as the primary bridge between the engineering team and program leadership, customers, and other cross-functional stakeholders — translating in both directions.

- Participate in engineering, architecture, and design review meetings to represent the roadmap and ensure business/mission context informs technical decisions.

- Support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reviews for major incidents from a program and process standpoint, ensuring remediation items are captured, prioritized, and tracked to closure in the backlog.

- Coordinate Tier III escalation visibility with program leadership, ensuring critical customer-impacting issues are communicated with appropriate urgency.

Team Technical Scope (For Context)
The engineers on this team are responsible for BAN/LAN/WLAN, network boundary engineering, routing, switching, and network security across an enterprise environment comparable to 16,000+ devices across 450+ geographically dispersed locations, including:
- Configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of switches, routers, VLANs, wireless access points, firewalls, and network sensors.

- Tier III escalation support and RCA for complex, multi-discipline incidents.

- Configuration baseline management, DISA STIG compliance, and pre-production lab validation.

The Product Owner is not expected to perform this hands-on engineering work, but must understand it well enough to prioritize it, staff for it, and represent it accurately to non-technical stakeholders.

Qualification s
Education & Experience
- Bachelor's degree with 8–12 years of relevant professional experience; or

- Minimum 3 years of experience as a Product Owner, Scrum Master, or technical program/project lead within a SAFe Agile framework.

- Prior experience directly managing or leading technical teams of 5+ engineers.

- Equivalent education and experience substitutions may be considered at the Hiring Manager's discretion.

Security Clearance
- Active Secret security clearance required.

Certifications
- A recognized Agile/Product Owner certification (e.g., SAFe POPM, CSPO, PMI-ACP) or willingness to obtain within 90 days of hire.

- DoD 8570.01 IAT Level II or higher certification (e.g., Security+, CASP+, CISSP) preferred; required if role involves privileged access to network management tools.

Technical & Domain Knowledge
- Working knowledge of enterprise BAN/LAN/WLAN and network boundary architecture — sufficient to read engineering designs, evaluate risk, and prioritize accordingly.

- Understanding of defense-in-depth principles and how they shape network security prioritization.

- Strong understanding of configuration management practices, change management processes, and lab validation workflows.

- Proficiency with ADO for backlog, roadmap, and reporting management.

Leadership & Communication
- Demonstrated ability to manage, mentor, and develop a team of 8–12 technical resources.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate deep technical detail into terms program leadership and customers can act on.

- Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience partnering with peer Product Owners to manage cross-team dependencies.

- Strong analytical, prioritization, and conflict-resolution skills.

Operational Requirements
- Ability to support occasional off-hours coordination for maintenance windows or major incidents.

- Ability to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications
- Previous experience supporting the Navy Marine Corps Intranet (NMCI) network or comparable large-scale DoD network environment.

- Previous experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) programs.

- Prior experience as a Product Owner or technical lead specifically within a network engineering, SRE, or NetOps organization.

- Working familiarity with network automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts (e.g., Ansible, Python) sufficient to evaluate related backlog items.

- Experience partnering with multiple Product Owners across a shared technical domain (e.g., a broader Transport or Network portfolio).

- Active or prior Cisco networking certification (CCNA/CCNP) a plus, though not required for this role

NGEN

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer — Product Owner
jobs.description:
Leidos is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer — Product Owner to join the Air Traffic Business Area within the Homeland Sector, supporting the development of the Leidos Common Automation Platform (L-CAP). L-CAP is a mission-critical, future-ready automation platform built on a hybrid cloud data mesh architecture, enabling next-generation air traffic management capabilities. This role operates within a SAFe/Agile framework as part of an Agile Release Train (ART) delivering iterative value across the program.

In this position, you will serve as the Product Owner for a development team in an Agile/SAFe environment, owning the team backlog and assisting in the design and implementation of software solutions alongside your team while working with program architects, customer stakeholders, Product Management, and DevSecOps teams. You will translate platform and mission capability needs into testable, prioritized work that the team can deliver predictably in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment.

This is a hybrid position requiring 3 days onsite and 2 days working from home, i f you are located within a commutable distance (Less than 1 hour's drive one-way during normal traffic) from Gaithersburg, MD; Eagan, MN; or Egg Harbor Township, NJ. However, if you do not reside within a commutable distance, you may be considered for a 100% remote role.

This role focuses on building and modernizing real-time, safety-critical systems using a combination of traditional systems engineering and AI-augmented software development practices. You’ll work on software that directly supports national air traffic operations, applying AI tools to accelerate development, improve quality, and enhance system reliability.

Primary Responsibilities
- Own and prioritize the backlog for one or more Agile teams, sequencing work based on stakeholder needs, program priorities, and dependencies, and ensuring the development team builds the right functionality
- Review program requirement documents, system specifications, and applicable FAA standards and orders to extract intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria
- Decompose high-level platform and mission capability needs into specific, testable capability statements (Agile features and stories) with clear acceptance criteria
- Maintain traceability from source requirements through features, stories, and verification evidence, ensuring compliance outcomes are demonstrable
- Engage customer stakeholders to identify use cases with an emphasis on completeness, testability, alignment with operational workflows, and readiness for validation and field activities
- Define team PI objectives, participate in PI planning and backlog refinement, make timely scope decisions, and accept completed work
- Systematically capture and communicate design decisions, performance trade-offs, compliance rationales, and risk assessments with each release, enabling reviewers to trace decision-making and provide informed feedback
- Prepare and review technical documentation, including use cases, user interface specifications, and interface definitions
- Coordinate with the Release Train Engineer, Product Management, systems engineering, and Test and Evaluation to manage dependencies and align delivery with integration and verification milestones
- Lead and participate in structured reviews and inspections

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience , or a Master's degree with 6+ years of relevant experience. (Equivalent experience may be used in lieu of degree)
- Experience and familiarity with Agile methodology, principles, and tools
- Experience in the role of Agile Product Owner , including owning and prioritizing the product backlog, defining complete product backlog items (user stories), making timely decisions on scope, and acceptance of work
- Demonstrated ability to decompose complex requirements into testable work items with clear, verifiable acceptance criteria
- Strong understanding of disciplined engineering processes, including attention to detail
- Past practical exposure to writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining software or scripts
- Experience with the design of cloud-based systems
- Experience in engaging customers to understand needs, deliver solutions, manage expectations, and maintain an ongoing relationship
- Experience working within a Scaled Agile (SAFe) organization, including PI planning and cross-team coordination
- Clear and effective verbal and written communication
- Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust
- U.S. citizenship required
- Successful completion of background investigations as required by the government customer

Preferred Qualifications
- Knowledge of and experience with AI-assisted development workflows and tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.)
- Experience with Java, Python, React, and scripting languages
- SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM) certification
- Knowledge of and experience with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
- Knowledge of hybrid cloud data mesh architectures and microservices platforms
- Familiarity with MBSE concepts and systems engineering integration
- Knowledge of air traffic control systems, air traffic management, general aviation, and/or flight services
- Practical knowledge of FAA/DoD systems, technical policies, standards, and orders
- Knowledge of FedRAMP, FISMA, or government security compliance frameworks
- Experience supporting verification and validation of safety-critical systems
- Track record of successful delivery on large government programs
- Desired but not required: Commutable distance to Gaithersburg, MD; Eagan, MN; or Egg Harbor Township, NJ.

Why Leidos?
You’ll work on systems where performance, precision, and reliability matter — every second. This is not experimental AI for prototypes. This is disciplined, responsible AI applied to mission-critical software that supports national infrastructure.
If you’re excited by solving complex problems in regulated, real-world environments — and using AI as a force multiplier rather than a shortcut — we’d like to talk.

jobs.title: Senior Software Product Owner (Agile SAFe)
jobs.description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?
At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Are you ready for your next career challenge?
Leidos Defense provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Owner with strong Agile expertise to join our team. The Product Owner will be responsible for defining and prioritizing product features, maintaining the team backlog, aligning with business and technical stakeholders, and ensuring delivery of high‑value, customer-focused solutions. This role requires strong communication, deep business understanding, and the ability to work effectively with Agile teams in a scaled environment.

Primary Responsibilities

- Serve as the customer voice for the Agile team, ensuring alignment to business goals and program objectives.
- Define, maintain, and prioritize the team backlog (features, user stories, enablers).
- Develop and clearly communicate acceptance criteria for user stories and features.
- Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to refine features and ensure readiness for Program Increment (PI) planning.
- Contribute to PI Planning, Iteration Planning, Backlog Refinement, Iteration Reviews, and System Demos.
- Work with stakeholders and the System Architect to ensure backlog items meet Definition of Ready.
- Support the team in delivering high-quality increments that meet Definition of Done.
- Make real-time scope, priority, and trade-off decisions to maximize business value.
- Ensure transparency into progress, risks, and dependencies across the team and stakeholders.
- Analyze customer needs, market trends, and business objectives to support product roadmap decisions.
- Promote Agile SAFe practices to continuously improve team performance and outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 12+ years of experience or 10+ with Master’s
- 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner or similar role in an Agile environment.
- Experience writing user stories, features, defining acceptance criteria, and guiding cross-functional Agile teams.
- Experience decomposing large feature sets into smaller subsets for team execution.
- Strong communication, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement skills in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
- Currently living in Huntsville, AL or willing to relocate to the North Alabama area.
- Currently holds a Secret clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in a large-scale Agile SAFe environment.
- SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) certification.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Automation and Intelligence
jobs.description:
General program information and/or position overview.
Leidos is seeking a passionate and results-driven Product Owner to lead and manage a portfolio of technology-enabled continuous improvement initiatives in support of our internal operations and Department of Defense (DoD) customers. This role will focus on delivering impactful process improvements through the application of Splunk capabilities and insights, automation, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Machine Learning (ML) technologies.
As a key member of our team, you will manage product development workflows in ADO and help operationalize solutions that drive measurable value. Your work will align with Scaled Agile and Scrum methodologies to ensure disciplined, data-driven progress across initiatives.

Primary Responsibilities
Core Product Ownership:
- Manage and prioritize the product backlog using Jira and/or Azure DevOps to ensure alignment with organizational priorities and strategic objectives
- Write clear, actionable user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria that enable development teams to deliver value incrementally
- Define and communicate the product vision and roadmap that supports the transition from reactive to proactive network management
- Stakeholder Collaboration and Requirements Management: - Partner with solution architects, software developers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into technical requirements
- Facilitate requirements gathering sessions with internal operations teams and Department of Defense (DoD) customers
- Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and development teams, ensuring clear communication of priorities and expectations
- Conduct regular stakeholder reviews and demos to gather feedback and validate solution direction
- Manage competing priorities and make data-driven decisions on feature prioritization

- Agile Framework Participation: - Actively participate as a key member of the Agile Release Train (ART) and contribute to Program Increment (PI) planning activities
- Support Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) ceremonies including PI planning, system demos, and inspect and adapt workshops
- Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
- Collaborate with other Product Owners and stakeholders during cross-team dependency planning and resolution

- Technology Solutions and Process Improvement: - Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on Splunk capabilities, including dashboard development, alerting optimization, and data analytics enhancement
- Support the implementation and optimization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) solutions for operational improvements
- Identify automation opportunities that reduce manual processes and improve operational efficiency
- Champion the adoption of proactive monitoring and predictive analytics solutions
- Ensure successful delivery of technology solutions that drive measurable business value and operational improvements

- Security and Compliance: - Ensure all product decisions and implementations comply with DoD security requirements and organizational policies
- Maintain active Secret security clearance and handle classified information in accordance with established protocols

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering, Business, Information Systems).
- 8+ years of combined experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role with Agile teams.
- Experience managing work in Azure DevOps or Jira and familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum or Kanban).
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate processes and identify areas for improvement.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
- U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a DoD security clearance, is required.

Preferred Qualifications
- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent Agile certification.
- Experience working in or supporting government or defense sector clients.

jobs.description:

Kudu Dynamics is Leidos Owned Company, forged out of a decade of experience in computer network operations and staffed with talent who have built, overseen, and enhanced capabilities throughout the entire USG arsenal. Kudu Dynamics, a Leidos company is uniquely qualified to anticipate tomorrow’s threats and build the next generation of capabilities.

jobs.title: Technical Program Lead
jobs.description:
The Undersea Systems Division at Leidos currently has an opening for a Technical Program Lead to support a customer site in San Diego, California. This is an exciting opportunity to apply systems engineering, naval operations, test and evaluation, and technical project-management experience in support of large-scale fleet activities and critical maritime missions.

The selected candidate will serve as the onsite Technical Program Led and senior technical representative, working closely with the Leidos Project Manager, customer leadership, engineers, fleet personnel, operational stakeholders, and government representatives. The position will support day-to-day onsite execution of program activities while also contributing directly to systems engineering, integration, test, and evaluation efforts.

Primary Responsibilities:
- Serve as the onsite senior technical representative for Leidos at the customer site in San Diego.
- Work side by side with customer leadership and technical personnel to support day-to-day program execution and mission priorities.
- Support the Leidos Project Manager with program planning, execution, customer coordination, schedule management, risk management, and delivery of program commitments.
- Lead and coordinate engineering activities across multiple technical disciplines and stakeholder organizations.
- Translate customer operational needs into technically sound engineering approaches, priorities, requirements, and recommendations.

- Experience working directly with customer, government, military, engineering, or operational stakeholders to address technical requirements and mission needs.
- Experience leading or coordinating engineering activities across multiple technical disciplines or organizations.
- Experience supporting program execution, including schedule management, deliverables, action items, risks, issues, stakeholder coordination, and status reporting.
- Experience developing, reviewing, or managing technical documentation, engineering analyses, requirements, system designs, integration products, or program deliverables.
- Experience analyzing technical or operational information and communicating recommendations through written products, briefings, status reports, and presentations.
- Experience facilitating technical meetings, program reviews, working groups, or customer engagements.
- Ability to work effectively in a customer-facing environment alongside senior government, military, engineering, and program personnel.
- Ability to balance systems engineering responsibilities with onsite Deputy Project Manager duties.
- Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, including overseas travel several times per year.
- Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance .

- Experience coordinating across government organizations, engineering teams, fleet personnel, contractors, operational commands, and other stakeholders.

Leidos has an exciting opportunity for a Principal​ Technical Project Manager (TPM) in our Intel Security Sector's Analysis Solutions Business Area .  Our talented team is at the forefront in Security Engineering, Computer Network Operations (CNO), Mission Software, Analytical Methods and Modeling, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), and Cryptographic Key Management. At Leidos , we offer competitive benefits , including Paid Time Off, 11 paid Holidays, Immediate Vesting in our 401K, Flexible Schedules, Discounted Stock Purchase Plans, Technical Upskilling, Education and Training Support, Parental Paid Leave, and much more.   Join us and make a difference in National Security!

Job Summary:
This role has direct leadership and interaction with one or more software development teams and performs as a key customer liaison with basic technical knowledge about complex system and application development. The TPM supports the Agile Release Train Program Manager (ART PM) and Technical Lead (TL) in developing Epics, Features and application roadmaps for the design and development of new and existing applications.  The TPM leads all aspects of a product’s design working with product managers to develop requirements and advise on prioritization.  The TPM also performs risk management identification and mitigation, and development of implementation timelines based on a tailored SAFe Agile DevSecOps environment. This role works with internal systems engineers to ensure customer priorities are planned through the implementation lifecycle. Experience with requirements management, portfolio management, Lean Six Sigma, and other optimization methodologies. This role is responsible for technical planning, coordination between Agile teams and mission customers; it also includes coordination of verification, validation, and deployments.

- Communicates large and complicated concepts to customers and technical teammates easily. Is able to adjust communication style to context.
- Ability to apply judgement and tact to challenge, recommend, and redirect teams as well as manage client expectations.

- Experience operating in SAFe and Agile frameworks with experience planning and leading major technology assignments.
- Experience evaluating performance results and recommending major changes affecting short-term project growth and success.

jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer - Product Owner
jobs.description:
Leidos is seeking Lead Systems Engineers to join the Air Traffic Business Area within the Homeland Sector, supporting the development of next-generation flight service and air traffic systems. This work aligns with the FAA’s broader initiative to modernize legacy flight service capabilities, replacing aging infrastructure with scalable, cloud-based platforms designed to improve safety and operational efficiency—particularly in remote and high-dependency aviation environments. These efforts focus on delivering mission-critical, future-ready solutions that provide safety-critical flight services to the pilot community.

As a member of a Scaled Agile software development organization, you will contribute to the technical execution of a program that integrates proven, globally deployed technologies with modern cloud-native capabilities. You will work alongside cross-functional teams and technical leaders to deliver predictable outcomes in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment.

In this position, you will serve as a Product Owner for a development team in an Agile/SAFe environment, assisting in the design and implementation of software solutions alongside your team while working with program architects, stakeholders, product delivery, and DevSecOps teams. This position supports government programs and requires the ability to  obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust investigation.

Primary Responsibilities:

- Review FAA requirement documents, advisory circulars, and applicable regulations (e.g., 14 CFR parts) to extract intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
- Manage the backlog for one or more Agile teams, prioritizing features based on stakeholder needs, and ensuring the development team builds the right functionality.
- Engage with customer stakeholders to identify use cases with an emphasis on completeness, testability, alignment with operational workflows, and readiness for validation trials.
- Decompose high-level regulatory requirements into specific, testable capability statements (Agile features) with clear acceptance criteria mapped to FAA compliance outcomes (e.g., performance thresholds, safety margins, required reporting formats).
- Systematically capture and communicate design decisions, performance trade-offs, regulatory compliance rationales, and risk assessments with each release, enabling reviewers to trace your decision-making process and provide informed feedback.
- Prepare and review technical documentation, including use cases, user interface specifications, and requirements traceability.
- Participate in structured reviews and inspections.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field with 4-8 years of relevant experience or a Master’s degree with 2-6 years of experience
- Experience and familiarity with Agile methodology, principles, and tools
- Familiarity with the role of the Agile Product Owner, including owning and prioritizing the product backlog, defining complete product backlog items (user stories), making timely decisions on scope, and acceptance of work
- Strong understanding of disciplined engineering processes, including attention to detail
- Past practical exposure to writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining software or scripts
- Clear and effective verbal and written communication
- Experience with the design of cloud-based systems
- Experience in engaging customers to understand needs, deliver solutions, manage expectations, and maintain an ongoing relationship
- Ability to obtain SF-85 Public Trust suitability determination
- US Citizenship

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Java, Python, React, and scripting languages
- Knowledge of AI-assisted development workflows and tools (i.e. Claude Code, Codex, etc.)
- Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
- Knowledge of air traffic control systems, general aviation, and/or flight services
- Practical knowledge of FAA/DoD systems, technical policies, standards and orders
- Experience with leveraging requirement-management tools (CAMEO, DOORS, Jama, Jira with traceability plugins, etc.) and documentation platforms that support linking, reviews, and exportable RTMs
